ratings_why.fun: The save-then-splurge rhythm gives real spikes and a turn-by-turn choice, and the Carnival grows in satisfying waves; the Hive half goes on autopilot once the bank is built.
ratings_why.distinct: Reading your own gold two ways (kept and spent) is a fresh axis no current tribe uses, though many payoffs are plain team buffs once the gate is met.

verdict_why: v2 fixed the Refresh loop and the tags; what is left is heat for the owner to balance, not a broken rule.

points.text: Once the Hive holds 20 gold, every Hoard fires each turn for free and the Hive stops making choices. A late card that pays for a bank that grew this turn would keep the Hive half active.
Lord Fennimore's 1 gold and +1/+1 a turn is too small to plan around by Tier 3. Letting him gain +1/+1 more each time he returns would make the drone worth keeping late.
Old Messor's Hoard 3 is met from turn 2 almost by accident, so he is a vanilla scaler. A threshold that rises with your tier would keep him a seed that asks something.
Madame Cigale buffing all units makes her the default late pick for any spending comp; that is fine, but the Carnival's own capstone could reward Carnival units a little more.

standouts.why: Tithonus is the crossing card the seed asks for: one turn becomes both a Splurge and a Hoard turn.
Mask-Maker turns a Splurge into a triple engine that works with any tribe's units.
Tymbal Drummer makes the splurge turn the turn you win the fight, a clear and readable spike.

weakest.why: Lord Fennimore's loop pays too little to matter past the early game.
Old Messor's Hoard 3 asks nothing of the player.

flags.note: Maestro Tettix with Madame Cigale: 20 saved gold spent on Refresh after base gold adds about 40 Tab, roughly +10/+10 twice to every unit.
Tithonus with Mother Melissa: a 20-gold Splurge makes every Hoard fire four times.
Golden Mask-Maker makes a triple most Splurge turns, which could chain goldens.
